author: Elmartinez21
quote:
Quite frankly this is not a grand theft auto game. It is incredibly stupid to make a love story be the main plot **** where the nature of itself is to be immoral and chaotic. So to turn this game to a simp simulator with Jason, is criminal. 

I mean, did it in gta5, gta4, heck even San Andreas. It is incredible that this got butchered so badly after 13 years of waiting. I dont think that this game really should be called GTA. Character development is shallow, and quite frankly, not a good game/story

the graphics are great, the things you can do are great, but again, not a GTA and would not recommend for longtime fans.
